card.name: The word routine before care or testing
card.fires_on: The word "routine" (or its start, ROUT-INE in capitals) when it modifies a medical activity such as monitoring, testing, assessment or foot care in label warnings.

modes.label: Routine before care
modes.description: "routine" modifies a preventative care or management phrase.
modes.example: Counsel patients about the importance of<< routine>> preventative foot care.

modes.label: Routine before tests
modes.description: "routine" or ROUTINE begins a phrase about monitoring, testing or assessment.
modes.example: ACCORDINGLY, ROUT<<INE>> BLOOD TESTING CANNOT BE RELI

card.writes: It promotes routine and similar words, so the model continues with the word routine or related inspection terms.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "routine" when a label talks about routine checks, tests or care.
